name: orgsync
description: Use your company's approved OrgSync context in your AI app: cited answers, exact source lookups, and sharing or source changes that you approve yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Your company's approved context, with citations
interface.longDescription: OrgSync keeps your company's current decisions and responsibilities available across your AI work. Ask about your company and get answers from the sources it has approved, each with a citation and an honest label: a reported fact is not presented as an accepted decision. When you want to share something with your company, the AI prepares a short draft, and nothing is shared until you approve it. Owners and Decision approvers can review suggested corrections and change a source's status, each confirmed in OrgSync's own prompt.
